title: СберИндекс: данные о границах и преобразованиях муниципальных образований
coverage: Full archive audited: 3101 attribute versions, 2660 territory_ids, 85 region codes. January 1 snapshots contain 2596 municipalities in 2023 and 2594 in 2024; each covers all 2016 IDs in the balanced consumption panel. Metadata scope: 2018-01-01 through 2024-01-01 inclusive; new regions and some Chechnya transfers excluded.
join_key: territory_id; versioned oktmo with year_from inclusive and year_to exclusive. Preserve region_code separately from OKTMO prefix.
time_semantics: Annual versions; within-year changes recorded at the start of the following year. Metadata does not establish all changes during 2024. Administrative-center changes were not dated; center retained from 2018.
license_status: Publisher explicitly states CC BY-SA 4.0 in official page snapshot already read; Rosstat and OpenStreetMap provenance disclosed.
access_status: 2026-09-14: official page GET 403, earlier official page snapshot and metadata retained. Published shortlink and direct RAR GET/HEAD 200; full 26925727-byte archive downloaded, SHA256 319ed22684b77716641bc15b61f7325adc44e9fc47e9be2973d88412d27d21f5. Existing Windows tar extracted XLSX and GeoPackage. Reproducible preparation and derived snapshots completed.
notes: XLSX: 3101 rows, no duplicate territory_id/year_from keys or overlapping ID/OKTMO intervals. Within each snapshot ID-to-OKTMO is one-to-one. Source oktmo is 2-3-3-3 hyphenated text; separate oktmo_digits preserves 11 digits including leading zeroes. Region code is independent of OKTMO prefix. Among 2016 primary IDs, 78 change both OKTMO and type between 2023 and 2024; none changes region. GeoPackage: 2660 unique IDs with non-null geometries, EPSG:4326; topology not validated. year_to=9999 is an open sentinel, not post-2024 completeness. No TERSON-MO equivalence established. Outputs: data/derived/enrichment/municipal_crosswalk_*.csv and municipal_crosswalk_audit.json; script: scripts/prepare_municipal_crosswalk.py. Names never join keys. Preliminary 3 MB probe remains an incomplete archive; full original preserved separately.

title: Росстат: ОКТМО, исторические файлы и изменения классификатора
coverage: National classifier with dated snapshots including 2023/2024; current metadata page also lists 2026 snapshot. Particular historical CSV contents not downloaded in this stage.
join_key: OKTMO string plus effective/source date. This source contains no established bridge to Sber territory_id by itself.
time_semantics: Do not replace historical codes by the latest 2026 snapshot. Observed historical filenames reference a 2026 structure version; filename timestamp is not independently verified publication availability.
license_status: Official open-data page links to https://data.gov.ru/information-usage; no CC license asserted here and linked terms not audited.
access_status: 2026-09-14: metadata page and https://rosstat.gov.ru/classification GET 200; exact listed download links extracted from official HTML. Historical file bodies not fetched.
notes: Use as cross-check and source of official code changes, not as an automatic polygon crosswalk. Classification page separately lists 2023/2024 amendments. Preserve leading zeroes, hierarchy and effective dates; merges/splits may be many-to-many.

title: СберИндекс: описание муниципального набора хакатона
coverage: Existing four-page dataset description; consumption January 2023–December 2024 and five named categories plus overall category.
join_key: territory_id in permanent boundaries; category and month.
time_semantics: Monthly model estimates of average noncash consumer expenditure of municipality residents, rubles; the PDF calls the field consumption, the actual Parquet uses value.
license_status: Explicit CC BY-SA 4.0 for the consumption data in the supplied description; preserve attribution.
access_status: Already downloaded and audited earlier in this session; no duplicate download. Local metadata and original ZIP preserved.
notes: Also addresses measurement_quality, but only partially. Resident attribution, rubles and category definitions verified. Common denominators, transaction/client counts, model weights, uncertainty, quality thresholds, missingness reasons and revision vintages not supplied. Source does not establish exact household budget shares. Keep these gaps explicit; do not infer them from arithmetic additivity.

title: СберИндекс: исходный consumption.parquet
coverage: Audited 303126 category rows, 2190 territory_ids, 24 months; 2016 IDs have complete history. Six rows per observed territory-month; no null/zero/negative values or duplicate original keys.
join_key: territory_id + date + category, unique in original data.
time_semantics: Monthly 2023–2024. Complete 24-month cohort is retrospective. Overall category can supply level context, separately from normalized five-category profiles.
license_status: Explicit CC BY-SA 4.0 with source attribution.
access_status: Already present in data/raw/consumption.parquet and audited; no new download required.
notes: SHA256 9833ddaaee7b2a182ed4cceeed16469031700ea87d508bd976150c6770ef8a61. Portal name-only exports are not the ID source: 2118 names for 2190 codes, with 49 colliding names covering 121 codes. Reuse original coded data.

title: СберИндекс: market_access.parquet, индекс доступности рынков
coverage: Audited 2571 unique territory_ids; 2170/2190 consumption IDs matched. Actual matched coverage for chosen analytical cohort must be retained in an enrichment audit.
join_key: territory_id, one row per source territory.
time_semantics: Static 2024 index, normalized to 0–1000; population-weighted inverse distance to other municipalities. Not a monthly or historical 2023 observation.
license_status: Explicit CC BY-SA 4.0 in archive metadata.
access_status: Already extracted under work/sberindex-research/hackathon-bundle/hackathonlicence; no repeat download required.
notes: Metadata excludes 22 municipalities lacking road/ferry connection; the consumption dataset has a different inclusion universe. This is potential external market accessibility, not measured trade, travel or purchasing flows. Use as a 2024 descriptive covariate with missingness retained.

title: СберИндекс: connection.parquet, автодорожные и железнодорожные расстояния
coverage: Audited 5942364 rows: highway 3303736, railway 2638628. Primary 2016 IDs: highway 2006 matched, railway 1262. Road and rail have different coverage.
join_key: territory_id_x, territory_id_y, type. Railway includes both directions; road has one direction per unordered pair in the audited file.
time_semantics: Distances in kilometers as of 2024-12-31. Road: OSM graph between administrative centers. Rail: station network near centers. Not monthly transport activity.
license_status: Explicit CC BY-SA 4.0 in archive metadata; upstream OSM and rail tariff-guide provenance disclosed.
access_status: Already extracted and audited; no duplicate download required.
notes: Road: 148 zero-distance rows; rail: 1319314 unordered pairs duplicated in both directions with identical values. Metadata claims one orientation generally, which does not describe the rail file. Preserve raw; resolve zero distance and pair direction explicitly before graph use. Missing pairs are not zero distance.

title: Росстат: численность населения по муниципальным образованиям на 1 января 2023 и 2024
coverage: National workbooks mix subjects, municipalities and settlements/cities. Main sheet Численность_по_МО includes total, urban and rural resident population, persons. Separate audited parser extracted 21069 rows for 2023 and 20406 for 2024 (41475 in total); these are all source levels, not a count of upper-level municipalities. No external join completed.
join_key: 2023 main sheet has names without explicit code in inspected header. 2024 main sheet has ТЕРСОН-МО, not an established OKTMO key. No automatic name join or code truncation authorized.
time_semantics: Point-in-time estimates at January 1 of stated year; not annual means. Official page shows file updates 31.07.2024 for 2023 and 20.12.2024 for 2024, illustrating observation/publication distinction.
license_status: Public official publication; no specific CC or other redistribution license established in this review. Preserve Rosstat attribution and check applicable publication terms.
access_status: 2026-09-14: official page and both XLSX files GET/HEAD 200; complete files downloaded, 1318101 and 1599578 bytes. Source rows extracted and audited separately in docs/population_source_audit.md; territory_id and oktmo remain null in the unlinked layer.
notes: Potential urban share = urban/total only for matching geography and date. 2023 columns A:name B:total C:urban D:rural; 2024 A:TERSON-MO B:name C:total D:urban E:rural. Municipality and its administrative city are distinct rows. Prefer coded BDPMO extraction until an explicit TERSON-to-OKTMO bridge is verified.

title: Росстат БДПМО: 8112027 население, городской/сельский состав
coverage: Official 2024 indicator list includes 8112027 for all municipality types; 8112014/8112015/8112016 for population by sex/age. Actual 2023/2024 cells and coded coverage require regional query/export.
join_key: Portal municipality dimension plus classifier/code and observation year; require explicit exported codes and reconcile to versioned OKTMO before joining territory_id.
time_semantics: Annual population at January 1; calculation accounts for births, deaths, migration and municipal transformations. Loading year 2024 is not automatically reference year 2024.
license_status: Public official statistics portal; no specific CC license established. Metadata links and attribution retained; do not infer unrestricted redistribution from accessibility.
access_status: 2026-09-14: national selector, methodology landing page and Adygea regional selector GET 200. Indicator 8112027 appears in live selector. Exported values have not yet been downloaded.
notes: Official extraction instructions: https://rosstat.gov.ru/free_doc/new_site/bd_munst/instruction.htm; regional example https://rosstat.gov.ru/dbscripts/munst/munst79/. Select indicator, municipality/type, year and period, then show table/export Excel. download_urls here are metadata, not a ready nationwide data table.

title: Росстат БДПМО: 8423005/8423006/8423007 работники, фонд оплаты и зарплата
coverage: Official 2024 list: average payroll headcount 8423005, payroll 8423006, average monthly wage 8423007, since 2017; organizations excluding small businesses, form P-4, economic-activity breakdown. Actual 2023/2024 cell coverage unverified.
join_key: Municipality code/version + period + activity category; explicit coded export and uniqueness check required. National bulk download not established.
time_semantics: Quarterly cumulative periods; January–December can describe the full reference year. Do not treat cumulative quarters as independent monthly values or sum cumulative wage means.
license_status: Public official statistics; exact redistribution terms not established in this review, no CC license asserted.
access_status: 2026-09-14: official indicator list and regional Adygea selector GET 200; 8423005/8423007 verified in live selector. Official bdmo_met2024.docx fully downloaded (162482 bytes), source main text extracted and wage/headcount definitions read. Actual observation export and missing-cell audit pending.
notes: This is a restricted organization/workforce measure, not income or employment of all residents. Commuting and excluded small businesses can separate it from resident spending. Keep wages and income concepts distinct; verify unit, enterprise attribution and denominator in metadata before use. The 2024 methodology defines nominal accrued mean monthly wages as payroll divided by average payroll headcount and by 3, 6, 9 or 12 months of the cumulative reporting period; headcount excludes external part-time workers. DOCX contains indicator names rather than the numeric IDs used in the separate official list. Local original: work/enrichment-sources/bdmo_met2024.docx; full main text is 169906 characters, while default Office preview truncates at 100000.

title: Росстат БДПМО: отраслевые срезы работников и отгрузки организаций
coverage: Verified indicator list offers economic-activity breakdown for 8423005 and 8401011 (own-produced goods/work/services shipments, excluding small businesses); form P-1/P-5(m) for 8401011. No complete municipal sector matrix retrieved.
join_key: Municipality code/version + period + OKVED category/version; require mutually compatible totals, suppressed-cell semantics and hierarchy before proportions.
time_semantics: Quarterly cumulative according to 2024 indicator list. Use an annual window consistently; do not sum cumulative quarter totals.
license_status: Public official publication; redistribution license not established.
access_status: Metadata and Adygea indicator 8401011 selector verified GET 200; actual data and nationwide compatibility not checked.
notes: Defer until crosswalk and the smaller wage/employment family are usable. These are organization-based sector proxies, not municipal GDP or the entire local economic structure. No income-of-residents series was established by this search.

title: Росстат / ЕМИСС: официальный каталог как резервный путь
coverage: Rosstat links to https://fedstat.ru/. A particular 2023/2024 municipal wage/income series with sufficient coded geography was not verified.
join_key: Unknown until a specific indicator and its geographic classifier are inspected; do not substitute regional values for municipal observations.
time_semantics: Depends on indicator, reference period, publication and revision history; not established for a selected municipal series.
license_status: No dataset-specific license established; public portal access alone does not establish a redistribution license.
access_status: 2026-09-14: Rosstat EMISS page and https://www.fedstat.ru/ GET 200. Dataset download unverified; no indicator ID invented.
notes: Retain as fallback, not as an acquired dataset or available nationwide municipal income panel. BDPMO is the narrower verified route for the chosen family.

title: СберИндекс: положение конкурса, требования к метрикам первого кейса
coverage: Existing official contest rules, including named case 1 criteria and metrics; not a data table.
time_semantics: Version of rules retrieved for this contest; additional task details may be published separately. Preserve the downloaded version.
license_status: Official rules; no general data license inferred. Cite the source and avoid assigning the dataset CC license to all contest documents.
access_status: Already downloaded and read earlier; local contest-rules.pdf and text preserved. No repeated download.
notes: Naming S_Dbw, AVI, AVU and MQ does not resolve every implementation convention. Existing docs/metrics.md fixes the implemented variants and sources; organizer-confirmed exact variants/denominator conventions remain a methodological gap.
